clauses.clause_label: No permission without prior written permission
clauses.scope_note: Applies to any part of this repository and to personal, academic, and commercial purposes. The text withholds permission for the listed activities unless the author gives explicit prior written permission; it does not specify terms for any permission that might later be granted.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the author has not given explicit written permission in advance.

coverage_notes: The supplied original is a repository notice, not a full software license. Lines 3–4 describe public visibility for review, evaluation, and reference, but do not expressly grant any of the listed activities.

The notice does not expressly address charging for access, providing network services, linking, providing source, or other activities not listed in its no-permission clause; no broader prohibition or permission is inferred.
The copyright and all-rights-reserved statements do not independently establish permissions or additional activity-specific restrictions.
